title: A time-series network approach to auditory verbal hallucinations: Examining dynamic interactions using experience sampling methodology
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-persons network
limitations: - Limited to continuous variables only; - Did not account for contextual variables or meta-cognitive beliefs; - Fixed time interval assumption violated; - Group-level analysis may not capture individual differences; - Reliability of centrality measures not fully established.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether it was preregistered. However, the authors mention that they report all R-code and model output in the Online Supplementary Materials, which suggests transparency but not preregistration.
